services_page.title: Our Services
services_page.subtitle: The Ministry of Mines and Petroleum provides a range of services to support mineral and petroleum resource development in Ethiopia.

licensing.title: Mineral Licensing
licensing.description: Facilitating the issuance of exploration and mining licenses for investors.

geology.title: Geological Information
geology.description: Providing access to reliable geological and geochemical data and maps.

laboratory.title: Laboratory Services
laboratory.description: Conducting mineral analysis, physical tests, and chemical evaluations.

petroleum.title: Petroleum Support
petroleum.description: Overseeing and supporting oil and gas exploration activities across the country.

investment.title: Investment Promotion
investment.description: Promoting Ethiopia's vast mineral potential to global and local investors.

regulation.title: Environmental Regulation
regulation.description: Ensuring resource extraction adheres to strict environmental and safety standards.

process.title: How to Access Our Services
process.subtitle: We've simplified our processes to make it easier for investors and stakeholders to engage with the Ministry.

steps.title: Inquiry
steps.description: Submit your initial request or inquiry through our digital portal or at our physical offices.

steps.title: Verification
steps.description: Our experts review your application and documents to ensure compliance with regulations.

steps.title: Processing
steps.description: We process your request, coordinating with relevant departments for technical evaluations.

steps.title: Approval & Delivery
steps.description: Receive your license, data, or technical report once all requirements are met.

excellence.title: Commitment to Excellence
excellence.subtitle: Our service delivery is guided by international standards and a commitment to Ethiopia's growth.

features.title: Transparency
features.description: Clear guidelines and open communication throughout the service lifecycle.

features.title: Efficiency
features.description: Streamlined workflows to ensure timely delivery of permits and information.

features.title: Technical Expertise
features.description: Support from highly qualified geologists, engineers, and legal experts.
